vol_hessian_blobness — 3D feature op

• Data kinds: voxel → voxel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_hessian_blobness(vol, scale, black_ridges=False) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import volops; volops.vol_hessian_blobness(vol, scale, black_ridges=False), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("vol_hessian_blobness"))

उपयोग

एक *scale* पर Hessian eigenvalues से blob-like (spherical) response।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

A bright blob has all three eigenvalues negative and comparable in magnitude; the response is the geometric mean of their magnitudes, (|l1| |l2| |l3|)**(1/3), gated to voxels where the three share the sign of a blob of the requested polarity (all negative for bright, all positive for dark). Normalised to [0, 1]. Complements the line filters — a Frangi-style Rb term rejects blobs, this one keeps them. Reference: the second-order (Hessian) blob measure, cf. Frangi et al. 1998 / Lindeberg scale-space blobs.
